deviations_from_card: (1) Card counted 6 tagged unions; at HEAD the evidence-board merge added ClipActBlock(kind), which the schema-derived detection picks up, so the codegen test expects 7 (that is the derived-not-hand-list property working). (2) Eager exports go through validator-only `$defs['entry:<Def>'] = {allOf:[{$ref}]}` entry points: exporting StreamEvent/EventFrame directly makes ajv emit their validators twice (+54 KB unminified, measured 256,472 B vs 201,849 B). (3) parseEvent validates the routed arm first and falls back to validateServerFrame before failing, so the accepted set is exactly unchanged (the card's plain shape routing would have rejected stray-key frames); errors are always the routed arm's. (4) ajv strictTypes requires `type: object` beside `discriminator`; forAjv adds it only where every alternative is type object, so nothing new is accepted or rejected. (5) Coupled files: 41 regenerated packages/contract/src/generated/results/*.js (counter renames, plus discriminator code in the event-bearing results), produced by the generator, not hand-edited.
